recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-20th-century album cover design featuring a high-contrast, slightly desaturated portrait of a female vocalist positioned on the left, set against a solid mustard-yellow background. The right side is dedicated to a structured, right-aligned typographic grid enclosed in a subtle dotted-line frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the left two-thirds while text occupies the right third.
High-contrast black-and-white photography against a warm, saturated background.
Strict vertical alignment of text blocks within a rectangular container.
coreInvariants: Dotted-line rectangular border for the text block.
Heavy use of bold, sans-serif uppercase typography.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Portrait of a singer from the waist up, angled slightly toward the center, occupying the left 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bold red artist name at the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's expression, moves right to the red title, then descends through the tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of flat yellow background provide breathing room between the subject and the text container.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and dark greens in the subject's clothing and hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the primary artist name.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with low-saturation, high-contrast photographic elements.

letterConstructionRules: Square-ish proportions for the boldest weights
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard mid-century grotesque forms.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family using weight and color contrast (Red vs. White) to establish hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider lines between text sections
Top banner with arrows for technical info

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, mid-century American grotesque feel.
Captures the utilitarian, newsprint-style aesthetic of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, desaturated portrait of a soul singer in 1960s attire, positioned on the left against a flat mustard-yellow background. Leave the right 40% of the image as empty yellow space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical rectangular container on the right defined by a thin white dotted line. Inside, place bold, red, all-caps sans-serif text at the top, followed by white all-caps sans-serif text for the tracklist, separated by thin horizontal lines.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent mustard yellow?
Is the text container right-aligned and bounded by a dotted line?
Is the primary artist name in bold red uppercase?
Is the portrait high-contrast and desaturated?

adjustableVariables: Accent color for the main title
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is overlapping the subject's face.
Check that the dotted line container is perfectly vertical.
Verify the red text is the most prominent typographic element.
Confirm the overall image has a matte, printed paper texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast monochromatic portrait on a solid warm-toned background with a structured, right-aligned typographic grid enclosed in a minimalist geometric frame.
